# 1bit.MONSTER

> One engine, any model. A model-agnostic, hardware-agnostic pure-C++ inference engine (MIT): 552 architecture tokens, 1,775 HF arch strings, 100% HuggingFace coverage, 317,310 checkpoints mapped, running on Ryzen AI NPUs and ROCm with a GGUF-native 1-bit pipeline. Zero Python at runtime.
